SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "event_space" IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND "capacity" >= 200;
2:
SELECT
    "id",
    "name" AS "event_space_name",
    "event_space" AS "type",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity" = '200'
    AND LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room');

SELECT DISTINCT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    r."food_service" ILIKE '%кафе%'
    AND r."cuisine" ILIKE '%итальян%'

UNION

SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine"
FROM
    "restaurants" r;

                r."name",
                r."address",
                r."food_service"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") = 'italian';

UNION ALL

    s."id",
    s."name",
    s."role",
    s."language"
FROM
    "staff" s

    LOWER(TRIM(s."role")) IN ('chef', 'server')
    AND LOWER(TRIM(s."language")) = 'english';
109:
SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    string_agg(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        systems s
    JOIN
        it_support_specialists_systems itss ON s.system_id = itss.system_id
    WHERE
        itss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;
111:
SELECT
    its."name" AS it_specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."name", s."system_name";
112:
WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

    r."responsibility" AS responsibility

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
ORDER BY
    j."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
263:
SELECT
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%software engineer%'
    OR LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%разработчик%'
    OR LOWER("position"."title") LIKE '%программист%';
264:
SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid";
266:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title,
    j."salary" AS position_salary
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs")
LIMIT 1;
